babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-technology.description: Babu Banarsi Das Institute of Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college on the Delhi-Meerut road near Duhai, Ghaziabad.
babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-technology.about: BBDIT was established in 2000 under the Rajiv Educational Trust. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and recognised by AICTE. The campus is on NH-58 near Duhai, about 20 km from ISBT Delhi.
babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-technology.address: 7th Km from Ghaziabad on NH-58, Delhi-Meerut Road, Near Duhai, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201206
babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

dr-k-n-modi-institute-of-engineering-and.description: Dr. K.N. Modi Institute of Engineering and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college on NH-58 at Modinagar, about 32 km from the Delhi border.
dr-k-n-modi-institute-of-engineering-and.about: KNMIET was established in 1995 through the vision of industrialist Dr. Kedar Nath Modi. It offers nine undergraduate and one postgraduate AICTE-approved programmes. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University.
dr-k-n-modi-institute-of-engineering-and.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

hi-tech-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.description: Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering and Technology is an AICTE-approved, AKTU-affiliated private college in Ghaziabad offering engineering, management and computer application programmes.
hi-tech-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.about: HIET is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, with some programmes under CCS University. It offers B.Tech, MBA, MCA, BBA and BCA. Its campus hosts an MSME business incubator and a robotics lab.
hi-tech-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

hlm-college.description: HLM Group of Institutions is a group of professional colleges on the Delhi-Meerut road in Ghaziabad, offering AKTU-affiliated B.Tech along with management, law and nursing programmes.
hlm-college.about: The HLM Group was set up in 2005 by Sunil Miglani in memory of his father, Harbans Lal Miglani. Its B.Tech programmes are AICTE approved and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, and other courses are under CCS University and other bodies. The campus is at the 11 km milestone on the Delhi-Meerut road.
hlm-college.address: 11th KM Milestone, Delhi-Meerut Road, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201001
hlm-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

ideal-institute-of-technology-3.description: Ideal Institute of Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college of the Ideal Group of Institutions at Govindpuram, Ghaziabad.
ideal-institute-of-technology-3.about: The Ideal Group of Institutions started in 1998. The engineering college is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University under code 028. The campus, Ideal Knowledge Park, is near Govindpuram.
ideal-institute-of-technology-3.address: Ideal Knowledge Park, Near Gaur Homes, Govindpuram, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201003
ideal-institute-of-technology-3.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

ims-engineering-college.description: IMS Engineering College is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college on NH-24 at Adhyatmik Nagar near Dasna, Ghaziabad.
ims-engineering-college.about: IMSEC was established in 2002. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and accredited by NAAC, and its information technology department is NBA accredited. The campus is at Adhyatmik Nagar near Dasna.
ims-engineering-college.address: NH-24, Adhyatmik Nagar, Near Dasna, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201015
ims-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

inderprastha-engineering-college.description: Inderprastha Engineering College is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college in the Sahibabad industrial area of Ghaziabad, accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade.
inderprastha-engineering-college.about: IPEC was established in 2000. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, with some programmes under CCS University. It holds a NAAC A+ grade.
inderprastha-engineering-college.address: 63 Site IV, Sahibabad Industrial Area, Surya Nagar Flyover Road, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201010
inderprastha-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

jms-group-of-institutions.description: JMS Group of Institutions is an engineering and management campus on the Hapur bypass road in Hapur district.
jms-group-of-institutions.about: The group's Hapur campus was established in 2010. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, CCS University Meerut and the state technical board, and is approved by AICTE. It offers engineering programmes in electronics, mechanical, electrical, computer science and civil engineering.
jms-group-of-institutions.address: NH-9 (NH-24), Village Rampur, near Sona Petrol Pump, Hapur Bypass Road, Hapur, Uttar Pradesh 245101
jms-group-of-institutions.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

jms-institute-of-technology.description: JMS Institute of Technology, formerly Bhagwati Institute of Technology and Science, is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college next to NH-9 on the outskirts of Ghaziabad.
jms-institute-of-technology.about: JMSIT was founded in 2008 as Bhagwati Institute of Technology and Science. Its B.Tech and other technical programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. The campus is beside NH-9 near Ghaziabad's industrial area.
jms-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

krishna-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.description: KIET, Ghaziabad is an engineering, management and pharmacy institution on the Ghaziabad-Meerut road that became a deemed-to-be university in November 2025.
krishna-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.about: KIET was established in 1998 with an initial intake of 180 students. It became autonomous in 2024 and was declared a deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act in November 2025. Its campus is on NH-58, the Ghaziabad-Meerut road.
krishna-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.address: Delhi-NCR, Ghaziabad-Meerut Road, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201206
